title: Blood Censor Pack (Cyan)
description: Censors the use of "blood" via changing the redstone block texture
body:
# Tired of seeing blood when punching mobs?
This resourcepack changes that by recolouring the redstone block texture often used to simulate blood on servers
![cyan particles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2f03f2bc85cabf27ae8069b3ca47a016b1c9956.png)
